# The thirty 0x02FF mob-move reports of the 01:21:37 run, 2026-08-19.

# Thirty mobs on map 40 were granted control (0x03D2, level 1) at 01:21:36.919-.924.
# All thirty reported exactly ONE move, at 01:21:37.122-.125 - every one of them carrying
# moveId = 1 - and then nothing for the rest of the session. Wisp, on screen: "the mobs
# moved for half a second before freezing again."
#
# Preserved here because world.log is a LIVE capture and rolled to a later session while
# this was being decoded. The later session (02:06:47) reproduces the freeze exactly:
# 30 grants at .242-.248, 30 reports at .417-.420, every moveId = 1, nothing after.

# Layout: research/mob-behaviour.md section 11. Two of these are unit-test fixtures in
# crates/net/src/mobmove.rs.
